_comment: Persistor wiring for Claude Code. Merge these blocks into ~/.claude/settings.json (do NOT overwrite the whole file). Replace the placeholder paths with where you installed the wrapper and hooks. The MCP server and hooks read DATABASE_URL, PERSISTOR_TENANT_ID, and PERSISTOR_NOTES_DIR from the environment (the wrapper and hooks source them from an env file). NOTE: Claude Code reads MCP servers from ~/.claude.json (via `claude mcp add`), not from settings.json — register the server with `claude mcp add persistor /path/to/persistor-mcp.sh`. The mcpServers block here is shown only for reference. See harness/claude-code/README.md.
